en: Black‑and‑white street view of a European town with a large, ornate villa in the foreground on the left, featuring steep tiled roofs, half‑timber and brick details, bay window, balcony with awning, and heavy ivy covering the garden fence. The cobblestone street curves gently to the right, lined with 3–4‑story residential buildings and a taller industrial chimney in the distance. On the right stands a simpler multi‑story building with rows of arched windows. Several people, including children with bicycles, stand or walk along the street. No visible text or caption appears on the image.
